results.name: axe-core WCAG 2.x A/AA on every module window and the shell chrome: no serious or critical violations
computed sizes: at the 125 % default nothing visible is below 12 px and body text is ≥16 px; in Large text mode (200 %) nothing is below 20 px
icons are SVG tiles (shelf, launcher, titlebar, palette, desktop) and every manifest icon resolves with the right type
reflow: at 300 % text on 1280×800 and at 200 % on a 360×640 phone the page never scrolls sideways and windows fit
text size is live: Quick panel A+ / A− and the Settings radio buttons change computed sizes, persist, and bad values are refused
spreadsheet grid geometry scales with the text (row height = 22 × scale) and a header drag still moves the edge 1:1 on screen
forced colours and prefers-contrast: more are honoured (buttons get system borders, muted text brightens)
style switch: the Settings and Quick panel pickers swap data-style, logo colours, auto wallpaper and accent; persisted; bad values refused
light + dark theme, all 13 styles: axe finds no serious violations in the chrome, Files and Spreadsheet
